nodes.label: Cannot Verify From Diff Items Protocol
Five Whys Backward Chaining
nodes.rationale: Trace backward step-by-step from observed failure to fundamental cause before fixing

nodes.label: Immediate Cause vs Root Cause
nodes.rationale: Fixing immediate symptoms leaves underlying defects alive, causing regressions

nodes.label: TDD Iron Law
nodes.rationale: No production code without a failing test first. Code without failing test is unverified

nodes.label: TDD Rationalization Defense
nodes.rationale: Defeats common rationalizations like trivial change, time pressure, or testing later

nodes.label: Name the Break Principle
nodes.rationale: Test names must specify exact condition and failure mode, not generic should work

nodes.label: Exercise the Real Thing Principle
nodes.rationale: Avoid mocking everything; test real integration paths and authentic contracts

nodes.label: Skill Invocation Before Response Rule
nodes.rationale: Never answer or clarify before finding and loading the matching skill

nodes.label: Verification Iron Law
nodes.rationale: Never claim work is complete, fixed, or passing without fresh verification evidence

nodes.label: Task Right-Sizing & 2-5 Minute Granularity
nodes.rationale: Tasks must be small enough to stay in context and verify immediately

nodes.label: Concise Guidance Principle
nodes.rationale: Instruction bloat harms recall; high signal-to-noise ratio maximizes adherence

nodes.label: Appropriate Degrees of Freedom
nodes.rationale: Tightly constrain high-risk operations while giving agents autonomy on open-ended tasks

nodes.label: Loophole Closing & Rationalization Table
nodes.rationale: Close every evasion loophole explicitly to defeat model justification tendencies

nodes.label: Psychological Triggers for AI Compliance
nodes.rationale: Leverage Cialdini persuasion principles such as authority and consistency to compel adherence
